question: Which lifts should be repaired or protected first?
answer: Repair now: Chinatown Elevator 876 (Oak Grove platform to Washington St/Essex St), Revere Beach Elevator 885 (Wonderland platform to lobby), and Back Bay Elevator 854 (Commuter Rail track 2 to lobby) — all closed and causing platforms to lose step-free access in the open-data model. Protect next: Alewife Elevator 813 and Downtown Crossing Elevator 891, which are working but already the last lift for some platforms due to current closures. Check mbta.com/alerts/access.
